item.title: Where did 400 MiB go?
item.description:
While doing some routine upgrades, I restarted hundreds of pods of a Nodejs websocket application. Every pod came back at ~250 MiB of memory, but one of them soon started to be hammered by some automation tool we have, and memory spike to 500+ MiB, and stayed there.

This pattern wasn’t new. I’ve been seeing this for months. Well, today I decided to understand what’s happening, and my first bet is the usual culprit: V8’s garbage collection.
